intent: Show and check the expanded C01 terminals from the existing exported KiCad and Gerber files side by side
permitted_execution: First tool action is start, without existence/environment probes. Only start and three review commands; poll their tool sessions if needed. No ls/file/pwd/git, wrappers, listing or output probes. The facade validates files and returns absolute display paths.
delivery: Display the returned PNG using its absolute path, add the returned concise report text and HTML link, then stop. Full measurements and hashes stay in evidence unless requested.
audit_strength: All original native checks, exact digests/facts, receipt checks, per-slice observation notes and gate order remain required. Only clerical copying and state lookup move into the stdlib client. Agent observes and supplies one note per slice; no automatic approval or full-workflow loop.
observation_custody: Full agent observations are retained verbatim. A short SHA256 reference passes through the unchanged native300-character note field. Client checks link full notes, displayed summaries and exact audit fields to native-owned audit requests; no truncation or discarded observation.
terminal: REPORT_AND_STOP; final paths, actual formats, sizes, dimensions, hashes and scope supplied
failure: Latch HALTED; never retry or probe around failure
language_scope: Bounded intent selected by the agent using project instructions, not a general English parser. Other crops, files, edits or later stages are unsupported.
setup: One local foreground native launcher is required; no MCP, installed service or global configuration. This layer does not sandbox another agent's other tools.
